# @splendidlabz/svelte

Svelte 5 components for Astro and Svelte projects: forms, disclosures, tabs, content helpers and media.

## Install

```bash
npm install @splendidlabz/svelte @splendidlabz/styles
```

## Styles

The components use class names from `@splendidlabz/styles`. Point Tailwind at this package so it scans them:

```css
@source "../node_modules/@splendidlabz/svelte";

@import 'tailwindcss';
@import '@splendidlabz/styles/base';
@import '@splendidlabz/styles/components/svelte';
```

## Use

```svelte
<script>
  import { Select, SelectOptions } from '@splendidlabz/svelte'
</script>

<Select name="country" label="Country" target="countries" />
<SelectOptions
  id="countries"
  aria-label="Countries"
  items={['Malaysia', 'Singapore']}
/>
```

In Astro, hydrate interactive components with `client:load`. Props that take a function or a snippet need a Svelte file.

Actions and utilities have their own entry points: `@splendidlabz/svelte/actions` and `@splendidlabz/svelte/utils`.
